commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' 2 - 5 Jim Allevinah (Angers) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom left corner.
90+1' Marseille fail to score from a corner as Herve Koffi (Angers) leaps to collect the ball.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) for Emerson.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Herve Koffi guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The linesman makes the right call and Marseille will have a corner.
88' 1 - 5 Igor Paixao (Marseille) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
87' Substitution. Carlens Arcus makes way for Marius Louer (Angers).
85' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) has a goal ruled out for offside!
85' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

81' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) is able to continue to play.

71' Igor Paixao (Marseille) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
68' A yellow card for a tackle by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille). Ruddy Buquet doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
68' It's a yellow card for Haris Belkebla (Angers).
67' Angers take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Louis Mouton (Angers) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The linesman points to the corner flag, Angers are going to take it.
66' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 29:71.

62' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Igor Paixao (Marseille) replaces Hamed Junior Traore.

61' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
60' Great teamplay by Angers as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Angers comes to nothing.

53' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the crossbar. Good effort! The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
52' The corner from Louis Mouton (Angers) is intercepted by Geronimo Rulli.
51' The resulting corner from Amine Sbai (Angers) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.
51' Amine Sbai (Angers) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
50' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
49' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Great chance! Amine Gouiri (Marseille) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Carlens Arcus (Angers) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Geronimo Rulli, who smothers the ball.
45+2' 1 - 4 Goal! Amine Sbai (Angers) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:4.

45+2' A sweet pass finds Mason Greenwood (Marseille) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Herve Koffi is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
45+1' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and signals a foul after Carlens Arcus (Angers) brought his opponent down. Marseille win a free kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

45' Amine Sbai (Angers) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Geronimo Rulli, who makes a glorious save!
44' Timothy Weah (Marseille) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Angers.
43' A raking crossfield pass from Michael Murillo (Marseille) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Marseille.

39' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

28' The Angers players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

15' Angers seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

10' A rebound falls kindly for Bilal Nadir (Marseille), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.

8' Amine Sbai (Angers) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
8' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Angers.
6' A pass by Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
5' Emerson (Marseille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

4' Timothy Weah (Marseille) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Herve Koffi leaps like a salmon to deny him.
